summary: The change propagates cancellation through deferred Lithos dispatches, releases late upstream responses, and adds coverage for both stream variants.

evidence: The deferred dispatcher now composes cancellable request/downstream signals and exposes a cancel callback in src/provider/lithos-handlers.ts.
Both Lithos Chat and Responses handlers pass that callback into the stream relays, which cancel late responses after stream closure in src/provider/stream-relay.ts.

The regression test covers both relay variants, asserts pending cancellation, exactly one late-body cancellation, zero upstream reads, and no downstream error frame in tests/oss-stream-lifecycle.test.ts.
